_schema: Registry of ops SURFACED-AS-PLATEAUED: driven to their roofline limit but still below MACHINE PEAK, with the residual-gap cause and whether any lever remains. Distinct from torch_fallbacks.json (which tracks torch/donor fallbacks). SURFACED FOR REVIEW at the end of the optimization + integration phase alongside the fallback registry.
surface_at: end of optimization + integration phase (review gate)

limits.primary_lever: eliminate [N,H,S] score DRAM round-trip via L1/L2-resident tiled epilogue
limits.residual_gap_cause: achievable DRAM BW is ~60% of the 358 GB/s datasheet machine peak (hardware delivers ~214 GB/s wall) + sub-ms per-layer dispatch overhead at low M. Not closable by further kernel work on this silicon.
limits.internal_fallback: best-of uses bmm (not the tiled kernel) at M=1 where tiling is overhead-bound (custom-to-custom, not torch).
limits.revisit: if achievable BW improves (allocator/NUMA/prefetch) or per-layer sizes grow (batching).

limits.lever_status: RESOLVED (chunked within-row pass-2 fixed M=8); ALL C/C++, no fallback. M=1 marginal on a ~10us op.
limits.residual_gap_cause: M=1 single-row is ~10-20us either way (torch.topk vs ours) — negligible; kept custom for a consistent single C/C++ path.

limits.binding: compute; per-query attention = M=1 GEMMs (no AMX tiling benefit)
limits.lever_status: RE-MEASURED at GROUNDED real dims (MQA,D=512,+sink): scalar 0.22-0.66x, AMX 0.31-0.86x @ M>=8 -> BOTH LOSE to torch BLAS einsum. Earlier 'scalar wins' was at HALLUCINATED dims (H=8/D=128).
limits.residual_gap_cause: q@kv^T and w@kv are batched GEMMs torch runs via optimized BLAS; hand scalar/bmm don't beat it. ROUTE to donor MLA flash at integration, OR author AMX-tiled flash (blocked softmax+sink).
limits.revisit: donor MLA flash backend at integration (if it batches heads into AMX tiles).
limits.shape_grounding_win: shape-provenance gate caught a kernel that 'won' at wrong dims but REGRESSES at real dims.
